sections.title: Summary
sections.text: Software engineer with internship experience building production AI agents, Large Language Model (LLM) workflows, and observability infrastructure for developer and support tooling. Comfortable across the full stack with TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, and Cloudflare infrastructure; passionate about shipping clean, tested code that puts users first.

entries.title: Software Engineering Intern
bullets: Designed an Intercom-integrated issue writer that auto-drafts customer-reported bug reports from support conversations, adopted by support reps for 97.5% of customer tickets.

Built lumadot, an autonomous Artificial Intelligence (AI) agent for automated code review integrated with GitHub Actions across ~11 organization repositories; became the org's most heavily used agent, reviewing 87% of merged pull requests, with GitHub App authentication and Claude Code-driven prompt/behavior design.

Built an issue analyst connecting the agent read-only to six external systems (Rollbar, Datadog, Google Cloud, Intercom, MySQL replica, Cloudflare) for cross-system triage, removing the log-access bottleneck for engineers and reaching a 79% approval rate on generated analyses.

Built luma-logger, a ~1,667 line Cloudflare Worker in TypeScript using Hono and Drizzle Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) over Cloudflare D1; exposes a read-only observability dashboard with run logs, ratings, feedback, and per-run token/cost metrics.

entries.title: Software Engineer Intern
bullets: Engineered Python data pipelines across Search Engine Optimization (SEO)/social datasets with automated Quality Control (QC), and improved Machine Learning (ML)/Natural Language Processing (NLP) workflows by migrating Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) to FastText and designing Large Language Model (LLM) prompts for relabeling/summaries and corpus curation/translation; boosted accuracy while cutting runtime.

Built analytics tooling and scalable infrastructure: Streamlit User Interfaces (UIs), Spark over Azure Blob, Databricks/Colab Graphics Processing Units (GPUs); generated JavaScript Object Notation (JSON)-driven charts and presentation-ready insights.

entries.name: Notion Planner Integration
entries.stack: Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, FastAPI, Notion API, Canvas API
bullets: Built a full-stack app integrating Notion with Canvas, Teams, and RenWeb for streamlined academic scheduling.
Automated assignment imports with a Python backend and JavaScript (JS) frontend, improving workflow efficiency.
